findings.quote: A familiar rule about which dryers burn, and a disputed account of why.
findings.note: BLIND: PARTIALLY, pick=D. No sibling stem in the unit touches price (A) or hire-versus-own economics (C), so both drop by cross-question topic aggregation alone, with no passage and no domain knowledge. D is then the only option naming both a settled claim and a dispute, which is exactly what q5 ('the writer's attitude toward Calverend's explanation') presupposes. The mechanism is partly inherent to any multi-question main-idea item, so this is the mildest finding in the unit; narrowing means giving A and C a foothold in the sibling stems.

findings.quote: Nothing at all had gathered on the newest ducts.
findings.note: BLIND: PARTIALLY, pick=B. 'Nothing at all' is a bare absolutizer on an evidentiary claim; a solver with no passage and no domain knowledge strips C on sight, taking the field to three.

findings.quote: She counts the old explanation dead and his replacement untested.
findings.note: BLIND cont. The q5 option set leaks the passage's argument structure - an 'old explanation' that Calverend 'replaces', plus 'the timing result' in q5 D - which entails that the swab evidence undercuts the received dust account rather than confirming it. That predicts B ('about equally dusty') and demotes A before any passage is read. The inference is chained rather than airtight, so flag.

findings.quote: They were never intended to be read as evidence at all.
findings.note: BLIND: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, pick=C. 'never ... at all' stacks two absolutizers in one option; it strips with no passage and no expertise.

findings.quote: They mark when a fire was noticed, not when it began.
findings.note: BLIND cont. C is a general truism about fire-service logs (they record detection, not ignition) and the only option that states a caveat, which is what a 'What does X say about the log times' stem with a named objector sets up; the q5 options confirm the timing result is contested. A is the no-problem option and reads as filler. B stays substantive, so flag rather than kill.

findings.quote: Every fire in the log fell within that stretch.
findings.note: BLIND: PARTIALLY, pick=A. 'Every' is a bare absolutizer on an evidentiary claim about the log; strips on sight.

findings.quote: Dropping the deduction schedule would end the rush and the fires.
findings.note: BLIND cont. A counterfactual policy over-claim ('would end the rush and the fires') - the second of four options to strip on form, so the effective field is two.

findings.quote: Growers face the same commercial pressure then, whatever they own.
findings.note: BLIND cont. The stem asks what is IMPLIED; D states a concrete throughput fact that a text would assert rather than imply, while A is the general inference and its 'whatever they own' aligns with the unit's dryer-type-does-not-discriminate line. Materially better than chance but not decided, so flag with material narrowing.

findings.quote: She shares the view that the call records are worthless.
findings.note: BLIND: PARTIALLY, pick=C. 'worthless' is an absolutizing evaluative, and A also mis-answers the stem, which asks about the attitude toward Calverend's explanation rather than toward the records.

findings.quote: She takes the timing result as proved by the county’s files.
findings.note: BLIND cont. 'proved' is the mirror over-claim at the opposite pole; A and D strip together as the two extremes with no passage, leaving the neutral B against C.

findings.quote: She counts the old explanation dead and his replacement untested.
findings.note: BLIND cont. C is the only split, calibrated verdict in the set - the standard shape of an attitude key - so a test-wise solver takes it over B. Not decided by form alone, hence flag.

findings.quote: What does the writer say about the pots on a single stack?
findings.note: BLIND: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, pick=A. The stem's 'on a single stack' scopes the question to variation between pots on one stack; B (what a narrowed mouth is for) and D (matching the ridge tiles and brickwork) speak to pots or stacks in general and drop on scope alone, leaving A against C.

findings.quote: A pot raised above the others marks a flue that had been drawing badly.
findings.note: BLIND cont. Ordinary building lore then decides the pair: heightening the pot on a flue that draws badly is the standard remedy, and the narrowed mouth in B is a draught device, the rain-and-birds reading being the popular misconception the option repeats. Domain knowledge is the deciding step and C remains substantive, so flag. Note the sole-hedge heuristic ('is mainly there') points at B, i.e. away from the pick - there is no hedge tell here.

findings.quote: The cart's hour, not the length of opening, governed how many letters a hatch took.
findings.note: BLIND: PARTIALLY, pick=D. B and D are contradictories on one axis (length of opening versus the collection hour), which marks that axis as the live one and pushes A (a motive imputed to the keepers) and C (the reverse causal claim) out as off-axis. D is then the only option that names both candidate causes and adjudicates between them - the shape an author writes for a key.

findings.quote: The shop that kept its hatch open longest took in far more letters than the other.
findings.note: BLIND cont. 'far more' over-claims beside D's measured phrasing, and the stem's 'implied' favours the counterintuitive adjudication over the naive expectation. Not airtight, since the 'X, not Y' shape is also written as a trap, so flag - narrowing means putting A and C on the same axis as B and D.

findings.quote: Varje mosse i socknen bar ett skikt som kunde tas upp med samma redskap.
findings.note: BLIND: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, pick=A. 'Varje mosse' is a universal quantifier and strips with no passage and no expertise, taking the field to three.

findings.quote: Malmen togs upp på vårvintern, medan tjälen bar, och rostades innan den lades i hög.
findings.note: BLIND cont. A and C are contradictories on one axis (frost-borne late-winter lifting, roasted before heaping, versus late-autumn digging and weathering before roasting), which marks that axis as live and leaves D as an off-axis exception clause. Standard knowledge of myrmalm decides the pair: the ore was taken while the frost carried the mire. Domain knowledge is the deciding step, so flag.

findings.quote: Samtliga blåsningar misslyckades så snart bälgtagen blev tätare än vanligt.
findings.note: BLIND: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, pick=A. 'Samtliga' is a universal on a failure claim and strips on sight; D deflects to a different question (how such a furnace should be built and dried) and sits off the stem's axis.

findings.quote: Att driva ugnarna hårdare gav ett sprödare järn, eftersom kolhalten i metallen steg.
findings.note: BLIND cont. A and B are exact mirror claims on the same variable, so the key is one of them, and elementary bloomery metallurgy decides it: harder blowing raises carbon pick-up and embrittles the iron. A is also the only option supplying its own causal clause and the longest in the set, a form lean pointing the same way. Narrowing: give B a parallel justification and equalise length.

findings.quote: Den äldre framställningen var i alla stycken underlägsen den som avlöste den.
findings.note: BLIND: STRUCTURAL_LEAK, pick=D. 'i alla stycken' is a total-inferiority absolutizer and strips on sight.

findings.quote: Eftersom anläggningarna var billiga att bygga kunde varje bygd förse sig själv med järn.
findings.note: BLIND cont. 'varje bygd' is a second universal in the same set, carried on an 'Eftersom ... kunde' causal over-reach.

findings.quote: Uppteckningarna från 1880-talet är den viktigaste källan till hur järnet en gång framställdes och hur hantverket var ordnat.
findings.note: BLIND cont. 'den viktigaste källan' is a superlative single-source claim - the third of four options to carry an over-claim marker.

findings.quote: Att järnet vanns i fast form bestämde både luppens storlek och var tyngdpunkten i arbetet låg.
findings.note: BLIND cont. A mechanical absolutizer/superlative sweep over this set leaves exactly one survivor, and it is the measured two-part mechanism claim that a 'vilket påstående överensstämmer bäst' key always looks like. No passage and no domain knowledge is used at any step - the only defence of A requires domain reasoning the form-solver never performs. This is the one question in batch19 where the sweep is decisive rather than merely narrowing; the fix is trivial (de-absolutise A, B and C).

findings.quote: Den är densamma på samtliga undersökta platser och kan därför användas för att datera dem.
findings.note: BLIND: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE, pick=B. 'samtliga' is a universal, and the option is self-defeating besides - a value that is the same at every site cannot date the sites - so it strips twice with no passage.

findings.quote: Den var snarast ett villkor för att processen skulle fungera, eftersom en järnfattigare slagg blir trögflytande.
findings.note: BLIND cont. B is the sole corrective option ('snarast') and the sole one carrying its own mechanism clause, against A's moralising 'vårdslös hantering' reading and D's 'därmed också' over-linkage. Bloomery slag is deliberately iron-rich so it stays fluid, so domain knowledge decides it; A and D remain substantive, so flag.

findings.quote: Utrustningen behövs, men föreningen bör bekosta den själv.
findings.note: BLIND: PARTIALLY, pick=D. C and D share a stem clause and C is effectively a special case of D - if the association should bear the cost itself, then by that fact the proposed fee is the wrong financing route - so C cannot be a uniquely correct key and a solver who sees the containment takes D. This is a material item defect rather than only a solver advantage: rewrite C so it is not an instance of D.

findings.quote: Den utrustning som finns räcker om skötseln förbättras.
findings.note: BLIND cont. Two of four options assert 'Utrustningen behövs', which makes that the consensus premise and marks B as the odd denial. No option in the set endorses the proposal as written, so the author's stance against it is readable from the option set before any passage is opened, leaving A ('bör sättas högre') as the implausible residue.

findings.quote: Sju av tio nätter blev obetalda.
findings.note: BLIND: PARTIALLY, pick=A. A and C are contradictories on the payment rate, so the key is one of them and both D (the sign coming down) and B (an inconclusive result) drop as off-axis.

findings.quote: Nästan alla nätter blev betalda.
findings.note: BLIND cont. The q1 option set contains no defence of the fee proposal, so the unit's stance is anti-fee before the passage is read and the ställplats anecdote is predictably cited as fees going unpaid; A also carries a specific figure against C's vague 'Nästan alla'. Cross-question stance leak - narrowing means giving q1 a genuine pro-proposal option.

findings.quote: Att titeln på varje bevarad blankett var skriven av abonnenten själv.
findings.note: BLIND: PARTIALLY, pick=D. 'varje' is a universal, and B is the absolutised twin of D: B entails D, so B cannot be a uniquely correct key and the qualified twin becomes the standing favourite. Pure form - no passage, no expertise.

findings.quote: Att yrkesordet i regel var abonnentens eget, där skriften gick att jämföra.
findings.note: BLIND cont. C sits off the stem's axis (what the blank form offered rather than what the preserved ones show), leaving A and D as contradictories on who wrote the title; D's methodological caveat is the researcher-hedge shape of a key and squares with q2's reconciling option. A remains substantive, so flag - but the B/D strength-variant pair should be rewritten.

findings.quote: Hon anser frågan omöjlig att avgöra.
findings.note: BLIND: PARTIALLY, pick=D. 'omöjlig' is an absolutizer on an epistemic claim and strips; A and B are the two polar stances (stands fast and dismisses the archivist / abandons and capitulates), leaving D as the only measured position, which is the standard shape of an author-attitude key.

findings.quote: Hon menar att båda förklaringarna behövs.
findings.note: BLIND cont. Read against q1 the routes disagree - q1's D would let the author simply keep her finding, which points at B - so the item is not decided blind. Flag rests on the A/B polarity plus the C strip, not on a settled pick.
